items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued November 8 at 1:19AM EST until November 9 at 9:00AM EST by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Isolated minor coastal flooding.

* WHERE...Coastal Palm Beach County, Coastal Broward County and
Coastal Miami Dade County.

* WHEN...Through Monday morning.

* IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.

station.name: Government Cut, Miami Harbor Entrance, FL
